caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a square-shaped textile with a rectangular extension at the top center, resembling a garment or decorative cloth laid flat. The textile is rendered in shades of beige and light brown, with intricate stitched or embroidered patterns. The central area features a geometric, stepped medallion with a floral motif at its core, surrounded by multiple layers of stylized floral and leaf designs. Scalloped lines and arches radiate outward from the center, enclosing several additional flower-like patterns distributed evenly across the surface. The border is marked by diagonal lines creating a textured background, along with small, spaced floral elements embroidered along the edges. The textile’s edges are slightly irregular, and subtle shading gives the impression of its thickness and the way it lies on a flat, light background.
title: Bedspread
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
